# Workspace instructions

This is a **multi-repo workspace**. The hub repo (this folder) holds no product code; it holds
the repo manifest, workspace tooling and cross-repo docs. Each other workspace folder is a
**separate git repository** cloned under `repos/` by `scripts/setup.ps1`.

## Layout

| Path | What it is |
|---|---|
| `repos.json` | Source of truth: every repo's name, URL, default branch, tags and doc path |
| `repos/<name>/` | Cloned repos (gitignored in the hub; each has its own git history) |
| `worktrees/` | Git worktrees of those repos (gitignored) |
| `docs/projects/<name>.md` | Short overview of each repo: purpose, stack, how to build/test, dependencies |
| `scripts/setup.ps1` | Clones/updates repos and generates `*.local.code-workspace` files |

## Before working in a repo

1. Read its entry in `repos.json` and its doc in `docs/projects/<name>.md`.
2. Follow that repo's own `.github/copilot-instructions.md` / `AGENTS.md` if present; repo-specific
   rules override these workspace rules.

## Rules

- **One repo per change.** Run git commands inside the repo folder you are changing. Never commit
  repo code into the hub, and never make a single change span repos without saying so explicitly.
- **Cross-repo changes:** when a change in a shared repo (tag `lib`) affects consumers, list the
  affected repos and the order to change, build and release them.
- **Don't edit generated files.** `*.local.code-workspace` is regenerated by `scripts/setup.ps1`;
  change `repos.json` or the script instead.
- **Adding a repo:** add it to `repos.json` (validated by `repos.schema.json`), create
  `docs/projects/<name>.md` from `docs/projects/_template.md`, and add any new tag to the `tag`
  picker in `.vscode/tasks.json`.
- Do not clone, delete or reset repos yourself; ask the user to run the
  "Workspace: Sync repos" task.
